ordered_diagnoses: Pleomorphic adenoma of the facial nerve
Facial nerve malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

s1.syndrome_frame: Gradual-onset unilateral facial weakness with a mass in the ear canal
salient_findings: Nonpulsatile mass protruding through the inferior ear canal
Mild sensorineural hearing loss at 4000 Hz
key_facts: 2-year history of gradual-onset right facial weakness
Initially treated with oral steroids
No hearing loss, tinnitus, imbalance, or other cranial nerve deficits
Nonpulsatile mass in the inferior ear canal
Mild sensorineural hearing loss at 4000 Hz
Irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen on MRI
Expansion of the fallopian canal and erosion of the posterior external auditory canal on CT
Lesion had heterogeneous enhancement on T1 with contrast
Specimen consisted of cartilage on gross examination
Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei on microscopic examination

shortlist.label: Facial nerve schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Gradual-onset unilateral facial weakness with a mass in the ear canal and heterogeneous enhancement on T1 with contrast

shortlist.label: Chondrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen and specimen consisted of cartilage on gross examination

shortlist.label: Chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone
shortlist.why_kept: Expansion of the fallopian canal and erosion of the posterior external auditory canal on CT and pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei on microscopic examination

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic adenoma of the facial nerve
shortlist.why_kept: Pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei and low cellularity on microscopic examination

shortlist.label: Facial nerve malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Gradual-onset unilateral facial weakness and heterogeneous signal in the stylomastoid foramen on T2 images

raw.rationale: The patient's 2-year history of gradual-onset right facial weakness, nonpulsatile mass in the inferior ear canal, and imaging findings of an irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen with heterogeneous enhancement on T1 with contrast are consistent with a facial nerve schwannoma. The microscopic examination showing pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei staining positive for S100 also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chondrosarcoma
rejected.why: While the gross examination showed a specimen consisting of cartilage, the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with a facial nerve schwannoma.

rejected.label: Chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone
rejected.why: Similar to chondrosarcoma, the clinical presentation and imaging findings do not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pleomorphic adenoma of the facial nerve
rejected.why: Pleomorphic adenoma is more commonly associated with the salivary glands, and the imaging and microscopic findings do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Facial nerve malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: The low cellularity, low MIB-1 proliferation index, and lack of mitoses on microscopic examination do not support a malignant diagnosis.
